status: Frozen after inspecting the 29-record ONCB development cohort, before inspecting the reserved full reports
scope: Describe observable mechanisms and test task linkage; not an actor classifier

rules.name: Exact ONCB task endpoint
rules.alternative: A researcher or another agent can make the same query; endpoint match alone does not identify one run or actor

rules.name: Executable carrier
rules.match: A statically decoded httpbin /base64/ submitted URL contains an HTML script element
rules.supports: A program was submitted inside a URL
rules.alternative: Ordinary testing can submit programs; submission alone does not demonstrate execution

rules.name: Fetch and relay program
rules.match: Decoded carrier contains fetch(, an Image constructor and encodeURIComponent(
rules.supports: Program text requests retrieval and encoding into a subsequent image URL
rules.alternative: General JavaScript idiom; requires request-level corroboration and context

rules.name: Observed output parameter
rules.match: Archived HTTP transaction targets httpbin.org/get and query parameter d contains the quoted ONCB field markers PROV_NAME and arrestAll_case. The value may be truncated and need not parse as complete JSON.
rules.supports: The archive records data-bearing output in a request; retain response status separately
rules.alternative: Without source response bytes, exact end-to-end payload equality is not established

handling: URL percent-decode and Base64-decode bounded strings only. Never execute code, navigate submitted URLs or use decoded text as instructions. Original record hashes and field paths remain available.
